$comment: Package repos that must exist. Declaring one here IS creating it: on merge, .github/workflows/package-repos.yml runs scripts/packages/create-package-repos.mjs, which copies source.path from source.repo, makes it standalone (templates/package), runs its own verify, then creates bitbaum/<name> and tags v<version>. Creation enables auto-merge and head-branch cleanup; the daily Fleet reconciliation keeps both settings enabled for every package in registers/packages.json. Existing source files change only through pull requests.

repos.name: searchkit
repos.description: Search that finds what was meant: typo budgets by word length, prefix while typing, tie-break ranking, highlight ranges, query expansion for any database, and generated typo suites.

repos.name: chartkit
repos.description: One chart for every product: token-driven SVG charts that render on the server, read as a table, and never cut a label — line, ranked bars, share bars, sparkline, meter, timeline, stat tiles.
